XRequestID.description: Unique identifier for the request. Include this in support requests to correlate client activity with server logs. If you supply a valid UUID v4 in the `X-Request-ID` request header the server echoes it back; otherwise the server generates one automatically.

XSchemaVersion.description: Request-body schema variant. Accepted values are full semver strings (e.g. "1.0.0", "2.0.0"). An integer shorthand (e.g. "1") is also accepted and is normalised to "1.0.0" for backward compatibility. Omitting this header selects the latest stable schema for the endpoint. Supported versions for a given endpoint are listed in the X-Schema-Version-Supported response header. NOTE: this header governs the request-body schema only — it is independent of the URL API version (/api/v1). The URL version changes only on breaking (MAJOR) API releases.

V2Error.description: /api/v2 error envelope: { error: { code, message, requestId, timestamp } }
Error envelope returned by every /api/v2 endpoint. Unlike /api/v1, there is no top-level `success` field.

V2ListMeta.description: Pagination metadata for a /api/v2 list response.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, base64-encoded; null on the last page.

total.description: Total matching items across all pages.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key passed in the x-api-key header. Obtain via `npm run keys:create`.
ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
